name: Pecans
description: Open source releases/downloads server with auto-updater

GITHUB_OWNER.description: Owner (user or organization) of the releases repository

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Access token with read access to the repository (optional for public repositories)

PECANS_REFRESH_SECRET.description: Enables the GitHub-signed POST /webhook/refresh cache-bust endpoint (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32)

TRUST_PROXY.description: Express trust proxy setting for TLS-terminating proxies (e.g. true or loopback)

PECANS_BASE_PATH.description: Path prefix when a proxy rewrites the path without telling express
